Teaching

I have taught since 2014: English to school and university students in Iran, and since 2023 teacher education and graduate TESOL courses at the University of Kansas. At Kansas I have taught seven courses as instructor of record, 16 sections so far, most of them more than once. Two more sections are assigned for Spring 2027.

University of Kansas

C&T 330
6sections

Instructional Approaches for ESOL Learners in the Elementary/Early Childhood Classroom

UndergraduateEvery fall and spring, Spring 2024 to Fall 2026

Teaching English learners in elementary and early childhood classrooms: who English learners are, the programs that serve them, core ESL methods, and building classroom materials.

I also supervised practicum placements in elementary schools in Lawrence, Topeka, Eudora and De Soto, Kansas.

Teaching in Iran

University of Isfahan 2019 to 2022

Award: Chancellor’s Distinguished Teaching Award, 2019

EFL instructor for undergraduate and graduate students, about 250 instructional hours.

  • 1716405 English as a Foreign Language II, undergraduate, 2019
  • E8012 English as an Academic Language, graduate, 2020 to 2022

IranCanada Educational Center Aug 2021 to Nov 2022

ESL teacher on contract, Tehran Province. I taught IELTS test preparation courses and designed and validated the tests used in them. I also worked on evaluation and teacher training.

Vank School (Armen) 2020 to 2022

EFL teacher in Isfahan, in two settings.

School classes
English as a foreign language to students in grades 6 to 8, whose first languages were Armenian and Persian (Farsi).
Evening classes for adults
English as a foreign language to the staff of the Prelacy at Vank Cathedral and to the head of the Prelacy.

Farhangian School 2014 to 2016

EFL instructor in Sabzevar, teaching English as a foreign language to students in grades 6 and 8. I also designed and validated English language tests for grades 6 to 8.
